purpose: Curated evaluation labels for passenger vs driver prioritization. Not RAG. Labels are research-use judgment based on genetics + causal perturbation + clinical pharmacology hierarchy.

label_policy.driver: At least two independent strong pillars (genetics and/or perturbation and/or target-engaging clinical efficacy).
label_policy.passenger: Clear disease association (often expression/biomarker) without adequate causal/pharmacologic rescue for the gene itself.
label_policy.insufficient_evidence: Real biology present, but missing enough independent causal + actionable pillars to call Driver or Passenger confidently.

validation.note: Only PMIDs marked VALID in the report are used below. Invalid guessed IDs were discarded.

cases.rationale: IL-4Rα is the clinical target of dupilumab; Phase 3 AD efficacy plus pathway coherence.

key_references.title: Two Phase 3 Trials of Dupilumab versus Placebo in Atopic Dermatitis.
Dupilumab treatment in adults with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis.
Open Targets associations for IL4R

cases.rationale: Direct IL-13 neutralization with tralokinumab and lebrikizumab shows Phase 3 AD efficacy.

key_references.title: Tralokinumab for moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis (ECZTRA 1 and ECZTRA 2).
Two Phase 3 Trials of Lebrikizumab for Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis.
Tralokinumab Efficacy Over 1 Year in Adults with Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis.

cases.rationale: Selective JAK1 inhibitors (upadacitinib, abrocitinib) have Phase 3 AD efficacy; pathway is causal for type-2 signaling.

key_references.title: Once-daily upadacitinib versus placebo in AD (Measure Up 1 and 2).
Abrocitinib JADE MONO-1 phase 3 trial in AD.
Longer-term upadacitinib efficacy/safety follow-up in AD.

cases.rationale: Nemolizumab targets IL-31 receptor A and improves AD pruritus/disease in Phase 3 programs.

key_references.title: Trial of Nemolizumab and Topical Agents for Atopic Dermatitis with Pruritus.
Nemolizumab ARCADIA 1 and 2 phase 3 trials in AD.

cases.rationale: Human germline STAT6 GOF causes severe allergic disease including AD-like phenotype; pathway is the effector of IL-4/IL-13.

key_references.title: Human germline heterozygous gain-of-function STAT6 variants cause severe allergic disease.
Dupilumab Phase 3 AD (pathway downstream of STAT6 axis).

cases.rationale: Strong human genetics for barrier risk, but no clear target-engaging clinical rescue of filaggrin itself comparable to IL4R/IL13 drugs. Causal biology ≠ actionable driver for drug prioritization.

key_references.title: Common loss-of-function FLG variants are a major predisposing factor for atopic dermatitis.
UniProt FLG entry

cases.rationale: Genetic association with AD exists, and biology is plausible, but AD-specific target-engaging clinical proof is weaker/less settled than IL4R/IL13/JAK1 for this benchmark.

key_references.title: Genetic variants in TSLP are associated with atopic dermatitis and eczema herpeticum.

cases.rationale: Strong inflammatory-state / Th22-related expression biomarker in AD skin; levels fall when upstream disease is treated (e.g., JAK1 inhibition). Not established as a primary causal AD drug target in humans.

key_references.title: Effect of abrocitinib on skin biomarkers in AD (includes S100A8 downregulation with clinical improvement).
S100A8/A9 neutralizing antibody ameliorates AD-like symptoms in models (preclinical; does not overturn passenger prioritization without human causal/clinical proof).

cases.rationale: Serum TARC/CCL17 is a widely used severity biomarker that tracks disease activity; association is strong, gene-as-causal-driver evidence for AD drug discovery is not.

key_references.title: Utility of serum TARC as a biomarker for monitoring AD severity.
Serum TARC levels correlate with AD disease severity in infants.

cases.rationale: IL-31 axis is clinically validated via IL31RA blockade (nemolizumab). Label gene as driver of itch/AD pathophysiology with pathway-level clinical support; receptor (IL31RA) has the cleanest drug genetics.

key_references.title: Nemolizumab (IL-31RA) Phase 3 AD pruritus trial.
Nemolizumab ARCADIA 1/2 Phase 3 AD trials.

cases.rationale: Core type-2 cytokine; clinical validation is via IL4R blockade (dupilumab) that inhibits IL-4 and IL-13 signaling.

key_references.title: Dupilumab Phase 3 AD trials (blocks IL-4/IL-13 via IL-4Rα).
Dupilumab treatment in adults with moderate-to-severe AD.

cases.rationale: Often co-expressed with S100A8 as calprotectin/inflammatory skin biomarker; treated as passenger/biomarker unless human causal clinical proof appears.

key_references.title: Abrocitinib skin biomarker study (S100 family markers fall with disease improvement).
S100A8/A9 neutralizing antibody preclinical AD-like benefit.
